content.text:
Changing the signature of `getPiiFreeCredential` could break 21 files: 7 that call it directly and 14 that call a function that calls it. I counted "two levels" as callers of the functions that call `getPiiFreeCredential` directly. Callers of those callers' own callers are a third level and are not counted.

I found these with the graphify call graph and `rg`, and checked the callers by reading the matches. I changed no files.

**Level 1: files that call it directly (7)**
- `packages/lib/piiFreeData.ts`: `getPiiFreeUser` maps credentials through it.
- `packages/app-store/getVideoAdapters.ts`: `getVideoAdapters`.
- `packages/app-store/utils.ts`: `getApps`.
- `packages/features/bookings/lib/EventManager.ts`: `createAllCalendarEvents`.
- `packages/features/conferencing/lib/videoClient.ts`: `createMeeting` and `deleteMeeting`.
- `packages/features/calendars/lib/CalendarManager.ts`: `updateEvent` and `deleteEvent`.
- `packages/features/calendars/lib/getCalendarsEvents.ts`: `getCalendarsEvents`.

**Level 2: files that call one of those functions (14 more)**
- Callers of `getApps`:
  - `packages/app-store/_utils/getDefaultLocations.ts`
  - `packages/app-store/_utils/getEnabledAppsFromCredentials.ts`
  - `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/apps/appById.handler.ts`
  - `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/apps/appById.handler.test.ts`
  - `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/apps/updateUserDefaultConferencingApp.handler.ts`
  - `packages/platform/libraries/app-store.ts` (re-export)
  - `apps/api/v2/src/modules/conferencing/services/conferencing.service.ts`
  - `apps/api/v2/src/platform/event-types/event-types_2024_06_14/services/input-event-types.service.ts`
- Callers of `getCalendarsEvents`:
  - `packages/features/calendars/lib/getCalendarsEvents.test.ts`
- Callers of `updateEvent` and `deleteEvent`:
  - `packages/features/calendars/lib/CalendarManager.test.ts`
  - `packages/platform/libraries/index.ts` (re-export)
  - `apps/api/v2/src/platform/bookings/2024-08-13/services/booking-location-calendar-sync.service.ts`
- Callers of `createMeeting` and `deleteMeeting`:
  - `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/requestReschedule.handler.ts`
  - `packages/app-store/vital/lib/reschedule.ts`
  - `packages/app-store/wipemycalother/lib/reschedule.ts`
  - `packages/platform/libraries/conferencing.ts` (re-export)
  - `apps/api/v2/src/platform/bookings/2024-08-13/services/booking-location-integration.service.ts`
  - `apps/api/v2/src/platform/bookings/2024-08-13/services/booking-video.service.ts`
- Callers of `getPiiFreeUser`:
  - `packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking/ensureAvailableUsers.ts`
  - `packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking/loadAndValidateUsers.ts`

Some entries fall in more than one group, so the groups above add up to more than 14. `EventManager.ts` and `CalendarManager.ts` also call other functions on the list, but they are already counted at level 1.

Some of these files only re-export a function or reach it through a type, so a changed return shape would not break them. Several test files that mock these modules, such as `handlePaymentSuccess.test.ts` and `getBusyTimes.test.ts`, would only break if their mocks assume the old shape. I left those out.
